title: Zero θ-weighted n-density of a set D at y makes its normalized blow-up integrals vanish (parent Step 7, I₃ → 0)
statement:
Let Q, n ∈ ℕ. Let D ⊆ ℝ^Q be Hⁿ-null-measurable (Hⁿ = μHE[n] on ℝ^Q), and let θ : ℝ^Q → ℝ satisfy θ(x) ≥ 0 for every x ∈ D. Let y ∈ ℝ^Q and φ ∈ C_c(ℝ^Q, ℝ), and write η_t(x) = blowUpMap y t x = t⁻¹(x − y). Suppose
 (∫⁻_{D ∩ B̄_ρ(y)} ENNReal.ofReal(θ) dHⁿ) / ENNReal.ofReal(ρⁿ) → 0 in [0, ∞] as ρ → 0+.
Then (tⁿ)⁻¹ ∫_D φ(η_t(x)) θ(x) dHⁿ(x) → 0 in ℝ as t → 0+. Here ∫_D is the Bochner set integral, and no integrability of θ is assumed.
lean_statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (D : Set (Eucl Q)) (θ : Eucl Q → ℝ) (y : Eucl Q) (φ : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap (Eucl Q) ℝ), NullMeasurableSet D (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) → (∀ x ∈ D, 0 ≤ θ x) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => (∫⁻ x in D ∩ closedBall y ρ, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q))) / ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (t ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ x in D, φ (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap y t x) * θ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
